purpose: Give an autonomous agent a bounded proceed or human_review decision for a prospective Pennsylvania vendor using legal-entity identity, OFAC SDN candidate-name screening, and domain registration/name/age evidence.

decision_policy.proceed: Unique strong Pennsylvania registry match, no OFAC name candidate at/above minScore, registered domain aligned with the resolved legal name, and domain age at/above minDomainAgeDays.
decision_policy.human_review: Any failed, ambiguous, contradictory, incomplete, recent-domain, or candidate-name condition. Source transport/contract failures are non-chargeable.

claim_boundaries: proceed is only a workflow signal that configured review triggers were not hit
a no-candidate OFAC name result is not sanctions clearance
OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis is not included
domain registration/name alignment does not prove domain ownership or control
recent domain registration is a review signal, not proof of fraud
a Pennsylvania registry match does not prove good standing, ownership, authority to contract, creditworthiness, or legal compliance
